ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising ~90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in localized streaks and at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Distinct linear white blobs are observed as vertical streaks in the medial-right region and diagonal streaks in the lower-left quadrant against a uniform dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 25% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The left lobe tip exhibits significant irregular jaggedness (macro-serration), while the right trailing edge shows more uniform, small-amplitude sawtooth variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex upward curvature from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly downward-tilted outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular and semi-circular pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes and sparsely distributed near the lower-left trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear pixel tracks; four distinct vertical streaks (rake marks) are mapped to the central-right lobe, and several smaller diagonal scratches are mapped to the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular truncation and jagged pixel loss at the extreme tip of the left lobe, indicating non-congenital mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive parallel vertical linear markings on the right lobe that break the dark pigmentation mapping in a repetitive pattern.
